section.title: Basic function
section.p: Smart Cruise Control can detect a vehicle ahead and help you maintain the appropriate following distance from it at the set speed.

section.title: Overtake Acceleration Assist function
section.p: When Smart Cruise Control determines that you are attempting to overtake a vehicle ahead, the function helps with accelerating.

section.title: Based On Driving Style function
section.p: Smart Cruise Control operates based on how you drive, taking into account distance between vehicles, acceleration, and reaction speed.

section.title: Overtaking Prevention
section.p: Overtaking Prevention helps the driver overtake only in permitted directions.
Overtaking Prevention helps the driver comply with overtaking regulations while driving.
